}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== [[Banana Pi]] logo and "ArmSOM-CM5 V1.2" are silkscreened on SoM top.
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: ''[[Rockchip]]'' RK3576 Quad-Core ARM (Cortex-A72) @2.2GHz :+ Quad-Core ARM (Cortex-A53) @1.8GHz *GPU: ''Mali-G52 MC3'' (OpenGL ES3.2, OpenCL 2.0, AFBC) :VPU: with 8K@30fps H.265, VP9, AV1, and AVS2 decoding :NPU: 6 TOPS @INT8, supports INT4, INT8, INT16, FP16, :BF16, TF32 mixed operation *Storage: 32GB (eMMC 5.1) Flash *Memory: 4GB (LPDDR4X) SDRAM *Network: 1x GbE port via connectors *Power Source: 5V via connectors
